newsitem.title: UK: UK budget will be prudent on tax cuts-Major.
newsitem.headline: UK budget will be prudent on tax cuts-Major.

text.p: Next month's budget will be prudent and the government will not cut taxes unless it is safe to do so, Prime Minister John Major said on Wednesday.
"It will be a prudent budget. If we can safely cut taxes, we will. If we cannot, we will not," Major told Parliament, repeating the last phrase for emphasis.

He was speaking at the start of six days of debate on the Queen's speech, made earlier on Wednesday, which outlined the government's legislative programme for the final, truncated session of the present five-year parliament. Budget day is November 26 and the general election must be held by May 22.
